audit.summary: The published variational identity/objective, contrastive mechanism, and mixup risk upper bound fail independent checks. Each supports a named core module. Missing implementation and raw runs prevent conclusions about which equations generated the published scores.
limitations: P1 — Invalid variational identity and inconsistent minimized loss signs — Counterevidence: Prose mentions correct environment-conditioned prior; corrected prior gives a valid lower bound but not claimed equality; tied variance interpretation limits unboundedness diagnosis; actual training code absent
P1 — Invalid variational identity and inconsistent minimized loss signs — Limits: Does not prove sufficiency/OOD invariance; no neural rerun; exact decoder/variance binding needed

P1 — Invalid variational identity and inconsistent minimized loss signs — Counterevidence and limits: The report distinguishes posterior from decoder variance and does not rely solely on a tied-variance interpretation. A conventional ELBO with the correct gap/signs would be a different expression.

P2 — Matched-pair denominator does not implement contrastive discrimination — Counterevidence: Supervised term may prevent overall model collapse; an intended corrected index is plausible but not evidenced by code or appendix
P2 — Matched-pair denominator does not implement contrastive discrimination — Limits: Index repair alone does not establish conditional-MI bound or OOD invariance

P2 — Matched-pair denominator does not implement contrastive discrimination — Counterevidence and limits: A supervised term may prevent whole-network collapse. This does not restore the claimed contrastive discrimination or mutual-information interpretation of this term.
P3 — Nuisance-information upper bound fails on admissible bounded regression — Counterevidence: No optimizer assumption is stated; adding it changes the claim; qualitative mixup intuition can survive
P3 — Nuisance-information upper bound fails on admissible bounded regression — Limits: No general corrected theorem or empirical change established

P3 — Nuisance-information upper bound fails on admissible bounded regression — Counterevidence and limits: No hidden optimality assumption appears in the checked statement. Additional approximation/optimization terms could change a repaired theorem, but are absent from the printed bound.

P4 — CompSolv solvent score and sensitivity runs lack consistent bindings — Counterevidence: Different configurations or transcription error could explain conflict; Table1 shows six lowest RILOOD means; other shared cells agree; no raw run identifies correct entry
P4 — CompSolv solvent score and sensitivity runs lack consistent bindings — Limits: No raw datasets or predictions acquired

P4 — CompSolv solvent score and sensitivity runs lack consistent bindings — Counterevidence and limits: Different configurations or runs could explain the values. The source does not identify a unique corrected historical score or parameter grid.
